title: Homogeneous localized pieces are split coefficient submodules
statement: Let R and A be commutative rings, A an R-algebra, and M an A-module with compatible R-action. Let A be graded by R-submodules 𝒜_n, and M internally decomposed into R-submodules 𝓜_i for i in Z, with A_n 𝓜_i contained in 𝓜_(n+i). If f belongs to 𝒜_d and j is an integer, any R-submodule H of M_f whose carrier is the set of fractions x/f^m with x in 𝓜_(j+md) admits an R-linear retraction p : M_f → H of its inclusion. No regularity, boundedness, or positivity hypothesis on d is needed.

source.place: Tag 01N2, standard-open calculation, agent-supplied graded-module refinement; fraction equality from algebra.tex Tag 07JZ.

proof.text: Construct the R-linear degree projections π_i of M from its internal direct-sum decomposition. Multiplication by f shifts homogeneous degrees by d. Check on each summand that π_(i+d)(fx)=fπ_i(x), and induct to obtain the analogous formula for f^n.

Define p_j(x/f^m)=π_(j+md)(x)/f^m. Equality of two fractions is witnessed by f^k(f^n x-f^m y)=0. Project to degree j+(k+m+n)d and use the shift identity to obtain equality of the projected fractions. This also proves independence of any exponent chosen for a denominator in the powers submonoid.

Common denominators prove additivity and the R-linearity of π_i proves coefficient linearity. The projected numerator belongs to the specified component, so the image lies in H. On H its numerator is already homogeneous of that degree and π fixes it. Hence p composed with the inclusion is the identity.

proof_origin.place: Fraction argument using Tag 07JZ; graded refinement of constructions.tex Tag 01N2.

theorem exists_homogeneousPieceAway_retraction
    {R : Type u} {A : Type w} {M : Type t}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Algebra R A] [Module R M] [Module A M] [IsScalarTower R A M]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R A) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜]
    (𝓜 : ℤ → Submodule R M) (h𝓜 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜)
    (hsmul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (a : A) (x : M),
      a ∈ 𝒜 n → x ∈ 𝓜 i → a • x ∈ 𝓜 ((n : ℤ) + i))
    {d : ℕ} {f : A} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (j : ℤ)
    (H : Submodule R (LocalizedModule.Away f M))
    (hH : (H : Set (LocalizedModule.Away f M)) =
      homogeneousPieceAway (fun i ↦ (𝓜 i).toAddSubgroup) f (d : ℤ) j) :
    ∃ p : LocalizedModule.Away f M →ₗ[R] H, p.comp H.subtype = LinearMap.id
